## Summary

Describe the reusable template behavior and scope.

## Verification

- [ ] `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] Translation/dependency/secret checks
- [ ] Generated Drift output is current
- [ ] Relevant Android/iOS build or exact limitation recorded
- [ ] Light/Dark, localization, accessibility and lifecycle reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, personal IDs, sensitive logs or commercial assets
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated when behavior or public API changed
